summary: Avista Corp. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 7.01 to report Q1 2026 results and hold a webcast. The filing only contains an earnings press release and slide presentation; there is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. Absent any special-situation substance, this is a routine earnings-related current report.
